name: website-improvement-loop
description: A 10-agent parallel website improvement loop: audit, improve over measurable iterations, test with synthetic users, pitch product features, and build the approved ones

scripts.verify: npm run lint:json && npm run lint:bash && npm run lint:mjs
scripts.lint:bash: for f in $(find . -name '*.sh' -not -path './node_modules/*'); do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done; echo '  all .sh parsed'
scripts.lint:mjs: for f in $(find . -name '*.mjs' -not -path './node_modules/*'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo '  all .mjs parsed'
scripts.test: npm run test:stop-hook && npm run test:guards && npm run test:measure && npm run test:report && npm run test:migration
